description: Ville de Paris lists an archived cycling route network for Paris. The full source description defines segregated cycle tracks, painted lanes, bus corridors open to bicycles and other bicycle routes. It describes bidirectional travel, cycling direction relative to general traffic, road speed regimes, segment length, arrondissement and placement of the infrastructure within the road. Further attributes concern restrictions on general traffic, bus-lane separation, physical discontinuities and the express cycling network. These explicit segment and direction attributes provide a concrete representation of the cycling network for network-flow studies; no observed cyclist demand or calibrated routing model is established. The title marks the dataset obsolete and the native listing was archived in June 2024. The provider states that delivery dates were removed because they were unreliable for some segments. Listed exports include CSV, JSON, GeoJSON and Shapefile packages under ODbL. Related references in the description concern Paris cycling information. File contents and present download availability have not been checked. Geographic coverage is Paris, France. A limitation is the archived status and unreliable delivery-date information.
